user_saw: Pressing Ctrl+C or sending SIGTERM during a Gateway-run `openclaw sessions cleanup` left the CLI waiting until the launcher force-killed it (exit 137 instead of 130/143).
summary: Passed the command's async-work abort signal into the Gateway sessions.cleanup call and rethrew the abort before the local-fallback decision.
reasoning: Like the sibling cron fixes (#187726, #197315, #199955), this extends the newer CLI interrupt-cancellation contract to an older command; the Gateway delegation path (#159223 and earlier) never took a signal, and the process still terminated via the forced-cleanup kill. The added throwIfAborted guard only protects the newly passed signal, so no earlier commit broke working behavior.
